Spectral Gaps on Regular Finite Graphs

1 Laplacian Setup

Definition 1.1 (Normalized Laplacian).

The symmetric normalized Laplacian matrix L has eigenvalues in the closed interval zero to two.

Lemma 1.2 (Spectral gap bound).

Every connected d-regular expander graph satisfies a uniform lower bound on the second eigenvalue.

2 Mixing Corollary

Corollary 2.1 (Logarithmic mixing time).

Lazy random walks approach stationary distribution in logarithmic time.
